spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (उद्गति)
To cast off or quit.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Risen, ascended.
2 Vomited, cast up.
3 Departed, gone.
4 Proceeded forth or from.
E.
उद् up, and गत gone.

f. (-ता)
A stanza of four lines, with ten syllables in the three first, and thirteen in the last.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Deceased, dead.
E.
उद्गत gone, असु breath.

f. (-तिः)
1 Going up, rising, ascending.
2 Bringing up, vomiting.
E.
उद् and गति going.

m. (-मः)
1 Going up, rising, ascending.
2 Bringing up, vomiting; also उद्गमनं.
E.
उद् up, गम or गमन going.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be gone up, or ascended.
n. (-यं)
A pair of bleached clothes.
E.
उद् up, गम to go, and अनीयर् aff.

n. adv. (-ढं) or adj. mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Much, excessive.
E.
उद् excess, and गाढ much.

m. (-ता)
A reciter of the prayers, &c. of the Sāma Veda.
E.
उद् up, and गातृ who sings, (the prayers being chaunted,) from गै to sing, and तृच् aff.

f. (-था)
A variety of the Arya measure, the same as the Gīti, a stanza of four lines containing alternately 12 and 18 instants.

Vomiting.
2

Ejecting any thing from the mouth.
3

Sound.
4

Speaking in the throat.
E.
उद् up, गॄ to vomit, &c. घञ् aff.

Vomiting.
2

Ejecting any thing, as saliva, &c. from the mouth.
E.
उद् before गॄ to vomit, ल्युट् affix; also उद्गारणं.

f. (-तिः)
A variety of the Arya metre, a verse of four lines containing 12, 15--12, and 14 feet.

m. (-थः)
1 A portion of the Sāma

Veda.
2
Designation of the triliteral name of

God.
3

Chaunting the Sāma Veda.
E.
उद् up, aloud, गै to sing, and थक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Raised, lifted, held up.
2

Erected.
3

Excited.
E.
उद् up, गुर to make effort, irr. participle past.

m. (-हः)
1 Taking up.
2 An object that may be accomplished by religious or other acts.
E.
उद् before ग्रह to take, अच् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Taking up.
2 Replying in argument.
E.
उद् up, ग्रह to take, and घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Taking up, lifting up.
E.
उद and ग्रहण taking.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Excellent, exalted.
2 Bound, tied.
3

Seized.
4

Deposited, delivered.
5 Taken or lifted up.
5 Recalled, remembered.
E.
उद् up, and ग्राहित taken.
